newsitem.title: USA: Visual Numerics files registration for IPO.
newsitem.headline: Visual Numerics files registration for IPO.

text.p: Visual Numerics Inc said Monday it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a initial public offering of 1,650,000 shares of common stock.
All the shares are being offered by the company, which estimated that the price per share will be between $2 and $3. Gordian Group LP will underwrite the proposed offering.
Visual Numerics supplies computational algorithm libraries and visual data analysis software.
